title: Each batch merge mails every live session to refresh
why: Owner 09:57 CST Nov 13 (via the retrospective): "we need to have some sort of auto update upon merge or something ... to ensure checkouts / sessions stay current". Start and owner prompts are the only refresh points today. Coordinator 00:57 CST Nov 15 (consultant 00:58): two lanes, both doing, started 00:56 CST, rebasing the open drafts. Lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy session_013NEJKzpBdiBYXja9cj5CoP carries #3020 (step field pr; REST 00:5x: open draft, head bc0b812ec521, mergeable_state dirty). Lane fast-forward-clean-start session_013NEJL1gBhLAKfnu1hoQKiy carries #3141 (open draft, head 07d1af67675f, dirty, review round 1 FAIL, fixes and round 2 pending per its PR body); the step has one lane and one pr field, so the second is held here. Both ids checked with get_session at 00:5x CST. The earlier lane session_013NEJL1XsPHDPWTxgsd5oS5 is replaced. 01:45 CST Nov 15: lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy (#3020) pushed head 9f8d1ead after the conflicted merge of main; its first fix check on 4c40d80e FAILED (caseK14 red, fixed in 9f8d1ead), the second on 9f8d1ead PASSED and is the only one posted (review record comment 6891202935). GitHub 01:44 CST: open draft, head 9f8d1eadc103, mergeable state unstable, base db3134aba78d (main moved since). Main's pr-review-record line 131 gives a fix after a FAIL fix verifier the fresh full review; no ruling covers a PASS after an earlier unposted FAIL. The lane recommends its posted PASS stands; the coordinator (01:43 CST) recommends one fresh full review at the live head, the route given to PRs 3465 and 3472. Owner item 866 (pick-3020-unposted-fail-fix) posted; b starred as the coordinator's recommendation; nothing parked on it.
note: Group "sessions stay current": grants-read-from-main (done, #2978), fast-forward-clean-start (#3141), cloud-hooks-stale-copy (#3020), roadmap-ref-fresh-before-verdict, and this step. Shape (retrospective proposal; triage pick, undo: drop this step): at each batch merge, the merge sends one mail to every live session: "main moved to <sha>; refresh". Each session reruns the install refresh and fast-forwards a clean checkout (c36 shape). The same mail carries the role-text notice from step role-text-follows-ruling: one mail per merge. Rulings between merges arrive through roadmap-ref-fresh-before-verdict. Done when: a test merge mails two live sessions and both report the new sha. Coordinator 11:49 CST Nov 13: doing, express (owner 11:47 CST: "more mechanical than just each compaction"). Lane session_013NEJL1XsPHDPWTxgsd5oS5. Group sessions-stay-current with #3020, #3141 and compact-refreshes-hooks. Two lanes since 00:56 CST Nov 15: see why.
